headline: Drowned Vale and Stema Landing Set Pace in Base Reports
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the line has moved most sharply around Drowned Vale and Stema Landing. Drowned Vale logged seven ownership events in the latest two-hour window, with Eastmarch and The Wash prominent in the day's tally, while Stema Landing added five events, including repeated work at The Wane. Dead Lands, which had earlier posted a four-event burst, cooled to two events in the final two hours but still shows the war's heaviest casualty rates and a fresh event near dawn. Endless Shore continues to lead the day with forty-two ownership events, yet it has gone quiet in the closing two hours, its last event at 03:32. Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf also settled after active spells, and Farranac Coast has slowed despite high totals. Tempest Island, Marban Hollow, and Loch Mor retain substantial daily event counts but little fresh movement. Most rear sectors remain fixed under one-faction ownership, with no recorded events in the past day.
